<!-- pr-reviewer: 12a0193d678625a4c4d56f71296d73af3d350375 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety-tier review. Deburr can now generate toolpaths in an aligned milling setup.

The material reader supplies setup-frame facets and bounds. The height reader supplies setup-frame model bounds. The Deburr kernel does not read the world. The stock and fixtures keep their setup positions. The part protection checks use setup-frame facets.

The new tests cover a whole-model source and a selected-face source. Both compare the turned part with the same turn applied to the mesh. They check the toolpath, the complete posted program, the expected rim position, and simulation with no gouges. Probe still tests the unsupported-kind refusal.

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2368`, with a trial merge of upstream/main at `a8bb30f0c`. The merge had no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| App build, selected test targets (`--no-run`) | Passed |
| App unit tests | 362 passed, 1 ignored |
| `fixture_locate_stock` | 3 passed |
| `heights_fixtures` | 8 passed |
| `opframe_picks` | 4 passed |
| `opframe_seam` | 8 passed |
| `setup_align` | 10 passed |
| `setup_align_2d_area` | 5 passed |
| `setup_align_2d_kinds` | 8 passed |
| `setup_align_3d` | 6 passed |
| `setup_align_chamfer` | 2 passed |
| `setup_align_deburr` | 2 passed |
| `setup_align_hole_kinds` | 4 passed |
| `setup_carry` | 9 passed |
| `stock_source_verdict` | 22 passed |
| Quick gate | All 15 steps passed; 453 tests passed, 1 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

I repeated two mutations in the review worktree:

1. I changed the material facet reader to `model::world_facets`. Both new tests failed. I restored the reader. Both tests passed.
2. I changed the `TopOfModel` height reader to `model::solid_world_aabb`. Both new tests failed. I restored the reader. Both tests passed.

Both mutations gave this expected failure:

```text
Deburr generates turned: could not generate the toolpath: Deburr: nothing to machine: deburr found no exposed edge inside the programmed window - an exposed edge is an open mesh's rim or a convex crease
```

The PR changes no goldens, UI files, dependencies, build scripts, or process files. No golden lines moved. The review worktree has no source changes after restoration.

Requested before merge: none.

The checks use the analytic L prism and the shipped 90-degree chamfer mill. They do not include a machine run or the release gate.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
